# 10-unknown-block-type

Invalid on purpose. The Overview view has a block of type `heatmap`, which format 4 does not list. `changescape check` must fail this folder.

The only problem is views.0.blocks.1, with the tag "heatmap".

A correct reader draws the rest of the view. The table "Changed functions" and its rows show as in 02. In the place of the unknown block, the reader says that the block is in the browser page. It does not fail the view or the page.
